name: Meta-World
description: A benchmark suite of simulated robotic manipulation tasks for multi-task and meta-reinforcement learning. Meta-World provides task environments rather than a single static dataset; trajectories are generated by interacting with the environments.
citation: Yu, T., Quillen, D., He, Z., Julian, R., Hausman, K., Finn, C., & Levine, S. (2020). Meta-World: A Benchmark and Evaluation for Multi-Task and Meta Reinforcement Learning. Proceedings of the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL), 1094–1100. https://proceedings.mlr.press/v100/yu20a.html

license.notes: The upstream repository uses the MIT License, which is a standard SPDX identifier (MIT). Verify the license file for the specific upstream version and any dependencies before redistribution; generated trajectories do not have a separate dataset license stated here.
